title: Document and test init --force semantics
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: `waystation init --force` (src/core/init.ts:29-77) re-writes config.json but deliberately leaves existing records and events in place, which may surprise users expecting a wipe-and-reinit. Decide the intended contract, document it in the CLI help and README, and add a test that pins the behavior.
acceptance: The documented `--force` contract (config reset vs full wipe) matches implementation.
CLI help text for `init` describes the `--force` behavior.
A test pins the chosen behavior on an already-populated ledger.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes:
Reported as audit finding #16 (cosmetic). If a full wipe is chosen, it must still go through the single write path.
